Trace, implement and test: leetcode594 longest harmonious subsequence sort and two pointers

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<unordered_map>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int findLHS(vector<int>& nums) {
        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        int L = 0;
        int r = 0;
        const int len = nums.size();
        int maxLen = 0;
        while (r < len)
        {
            while (nums[r] - nums[L] > 1)
                L++;
            if (nums[r] - nums[L] == 1)
                maxLen = max(maxLen, r - L + 1);
            r++;
        }
        return maxLen;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {1, 3, 2, 2, 5, 2, 3, 7};
    auto res = sol.findLHS(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
